title.zh: 极限与 ε–δ · 你说多近，我就能多近
title.en: Limits and ε–δ · Name How Close, and I Can Get That Close

desc.zh: 把“无限接近”变成一场有规则的博弈：对方先给出 ε（允许的误差），你要找出 δ（x 离 a 多近就够了）。
desc.en: Turn "gets arbitrarily close" into a game with rules: the opponent gives ε (the allowed error) and you must find δ (how close x must be to a).
